# googleplay_users (Data Source)

Every user of the Play Console developer account, with their account-wide permissions and their per-app grants. Use it to see what already exists and to write the `import` blocks for `googleplay_user` (id: `email`) and `googleplay_app_grant` (id: `email/package_name`).

The API returns all users in one response and cannot page. Requires the provider's `developer_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleplay_users" "all" {}

# Who is in the developer account, and what each can do across it.
output "users" {
  value = {
    for user in data.googleplay_users.all.users :
    user.email => user.developer_account_permissions
  }
}

# The import id of every per-app grant, ready to paste into import blocks:
# "email/package_name" for googleplay_app_grant, "email" for googleplay_user.
output "app_grant_import_ids" {
  value = flatten([
    for user in data.googleplay_users.all.users : [
      for grant in user.grants : "${user.email}/${grant.package_name}"
      if grant.package_name != null
    ]
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The users of the developer account, ordered by email address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `access_state` (String) The state of the user's access: `INVITED`, `INVITATION_EXPIRED`, `ACCESS_GRANTED` or `ACCESS_EXPIRED`.
- `developer_account_permissions` (Set of String) The permissions that apply to every app of the account. Empty for a user who only holds per-app grants.
- `email` (String) The user's email address, as Play Console holds it. It is the import id of a `googleplay_user`.
- `expiration_time` (String) When the user's access expires, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Null for access that does not expire.
- `grants` (Attributes List) The user's per-app permissions, ordered by package name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--grants))
- `name` (String) The API resource name, `developers/{developer}/users/{email}`.
- `partial` (Boolean) Whether the user holds permissions the API does not show, which is the case for the account owner and when the credentials cannot manage every app. Such a user cannot be fully managed.

<a id="nestedatt--users--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.grants`

Read-Only:

- `app_level_permissions` (Set of String) The permissions granted on the app.
- `name` (String) The API resource name, `developers/{developer}/users/{email}/grants/{package_name}`.
- `package_name` (String) The package name of the app. Null for a draft app, which the API identifies only in `name`; such a grant cannot be managed as a `googleplay_app_grant`.
